title: Help
heading: How OpenFarmPlanner works
intro: OpenFarmPlanner consists of several pages that work together:

sections.title: Overview
points: See upcoming sowing, planting, propagation and harvest dates at a glance.

sections.title: Growing areas
points: Create fields and beds here. Add extra locations when you need them.

sections.title: Crops
points: Enter your crop data here, or draw on the crop library.

sections.title: Planting plans
points: Plan which crop is grown on which bed and when.

sections.title: Planting calendar
points: See the timeline for your planting plans here.

sections.title: Yield overview
points: See the harvest quantities expected from your planting plans.

sections.title: Seed demand
points: This calculates how much seed you need.

sections.title: Suppliers
points: Record your suppliers here so you can link them to crops.

workflow: Growing areas → Crops → Planting plans → Planting calendar → Seed demand

dashboard.title: Help: Overview
dashboard.intro: Once planting plans exist, upcoming tasks for sowing, transplanting, propagation, and harvest appear here.

locations.title: Help: Locations
locations.intro: Manage the locations in your project here. They form the top level of your growing area structure.

sections.title: How to use it
points: Create locations and add coordinates, address, soil type, or notes.
Edit existing locations from the list actions.

sections.title: How this connects to other pages
points: On the growing areas page, you add fields and beds for each location.
Tasks are derived from the planting plans.

fields.title: Help: Fields
fields.intro: Manage fields within a location here. A field groups multiple beds.

sections.title: How to use it
points: Use “New” to create a field.
Click table rows to edit entries.

beds.title: Help: Beds
beds.intro: Manage your beds here. Each bed belongs to a field and can later be used in planting plans.

sections.title: How to use it
points: Use “New” to create a bed.
Click table rows to edit entries.

sections.title: How this connects to other pages
points: In planting plans, you assign crops to specific beds.

areas.title: Help: Growing areas - list view
areas.intro:
Manage your farm's area structure here — from locations through plots down to individual beds.

New locations, plots and beds are added with the {{addIcon}} that appears when you hover over an element.

Entries can be edited directly in the table. The {{createPlanIcon}} on a bed creates a planting plan for it straight away. Further actions such as renaming or deleting are in the right-click context menu.

symbols.createPlan: Create a planting plan for this bed
symbols.dimensions: Set length and width orientation for the graphical view

crops.title: Help: Crop library
crops.intro: Manage crops and their key properties here. These data are used in planting plans, calendar, and seed demand.

sections.title: How to use it
points: Select a crop to view or edit details.
The {{moreIcon}} opens further actions such as versions, publishing to the crop library, or deleting the selected crop.
Use the crop library to share or import crops.

sections.title: How this connects to other pages
points: In planting plans, you assign crops to specific beds and time periods.
The planting calendar and seed demand use these data for timing and quantity planning.

symbols.createPlan: Create a planting plan for this crop

cropLibrary.title: Help: Crop library
cropLibrary.intro: The crop library contains community-published crops that can be used across projects.

sections.title: Collaboration
points: Signed-in users can edit public crops together.
Every change is saved as a version with time and author.
Older versions can be restored without deleting the version history.

sections.title: Using crops
points: Import useful crops as your own project copy into the current project.
Already imported project crops stay independent from later changes in the crop library.

plantingPlans.title: Help: Planting plans
plantingPlans.intro: Plan which crop is grown in which bed and when.

symbols.mobileAdd: Quickly create a new entry on mobile
symbols.notes: Open notes and attachments for an entry
symbols.edit: Change values directly in the table

calendar.title: Help: Planting calendar
calendar.intro: The planting calendar shows the timeline of your planting plans. It helps you spot occupancy, propagation phases, and possible overlaps.

symbols.tabs: Switch between occupancy and propagation views

seedDemand.title: Help: Seed demand
seedDemand.intro: See how much seed you need for your planned crops. Quantities are calculated from crop data, areas, and planting plan entries.

youngPlantDemand.title: Help: Young plant demand
youngPlantDemand.intro:
This page shows how many young plants to order for the active season's transplants with bought-in plants, grouped by crop, variety and planting week.

The quantity comes from each planting plan's area and the crop's in-row and row spacing. The reserve for losses is rounded up to whole plants.

symbols.expand: Show or hide the underlying planting plans

suppliers.title: Help: Suppliers
suppliers.intro: Manage seed suppliers and their package information here.

graphical.title: Help: Growing areas - graphical view
graphical.intro: See locations, fields, and beds arranged spatially here. The graphical view helps you review and adjust the area structure visually.

sections.title: How to use it
points: Click a bed or field to show details.
Move elements in “Edit” mode.
Drag empty space to pan the view.
Zoom with the mouse wheel or a pinch gesture.

sections.title: How this connects to other pages
points: The graphical view shows the same areas as the list view.

symbols.panArrows: Move view up, left, right, or down
symbols.editToggle: Edit layout: drag and drop to move and arrange a location's beds and fields

yieldOverview.title: Help: Yield overview
yieldOverview.intro: The yield overview shows expected harvest quantities from your planting plans.
